[SWS_DM_01264]
DiagnosticAging.threshold
reached
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04133
⌈
The
DiagnosticAging.threshold
defines the number of
Aging
cycles until
Ag-
ing
. If the threshold is reached, the
event memory
entry shall be deleted (aged)
from the
event memory
including the
snapshot records
and
extended data
records
belonging to that aged DTC.
⌋
